title: The Lady of Monza
writer: Giampiero Bona, Edward Bond, Mario Mazzucchelli
actors: Anne Heywood, Antonio Sabato, Hardy Krüger
plot: A film loosely based on real life events of Marianna De Leyva, better known as "The Nun of Monza," a 17th century nun accused of and tried by the church for breaking celibacy and plotting murder.
